drivers: A1c 6.7 in the 6.5-6.9 band (type 2 diabetes rated on A1c)
Late-onset diabetes credit: first diagnosed after age 45 with A1c below 7.0, per senior guidance
rationale: A1c 6.7 rates 50 debits (section 6). Senior confirmed house practice: type 2 diabetes first diagnosed after 45 with A1c below 7.0 earns a 25-debit credit; diagnosed 2019 at about 49, diet controlled, so net 25. Build, BP, lipids, tobacco, family history, occupation, driving, liver and financial multiple (15x) carry zero. Total 25 is Standard; the diabetes diagnosis bars preferred classes. Judgement used on the section 16 cardiac-combination referral: no additional charge.
